A Comprehensive Tutorial on Inclusion-Exclusion
By tourist

In this post, we discuss the principle of inclusion-exclusion (PIE) in competitive programming.

Given finite sets $A_1, A_2, \dots, A_n$, the size of their union is calculated by alternating sums of intersections.

We will examine applications in counting derangements and coprime pairs in an array.
